author: thisfoxgoeswild

title: I chose this one
body:
I tried multiple apps of this kind but chose this one because the complexity of the app is well balanced - not too many additional things but it’s still fun. The system of taking care of your pet (that’s the cutest 😀) and getting coins is well set to keep you motivated. An app like this can really change your life if you have ADHD and nothing helps you get the things done! 
The only thing I’d appreciate is an apple watch widget, if it’s available, I can’t find it.

title: Finch is the best!
body:
In comparison to other self-motivation and self-care apps, Finch is really easy to use and very friendly, not forcing users to spend time with it, but offering so much to help remain self-confident and focused. I’d had it only for few days and I have already had suggested it to many of my friends 🤩
A perfect daily dose of adorableness and motivation 😌
